_comment: Machine-local QMT install paths (quote=行情, trade=交易). Copy to scripts/qmt/qmt_instances.local.json (gitignored). python_dir optional — defaults to <root>\python. account_id derives ZMQ port 15560+(id%%100). Used by sync_qmt_rpc_deployment.py and probe helpers; NOT read by run_miniqmt_bridge at runtime (bridge uses bigqmt_rpc_bridge.json for ZMQ only).
